method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fair Work Act 2009, Compilation No. 73, compilation date 7 July 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 62, 2026; register id C2026C00355), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2009A00028.txt; with the Fair Work Regulations 2009 (F2009L02356), Compilation No. 57, compilation date 1 October 2026 (register id F2026C00996), as deposited at ../../../fair-work-regulations-2009/registers/source-bundle/F2009L02356.txt (regs 1.08AA, 2.00, 2.13, 3.31 to 3.40, 3.42, 3.46, 4.01; regs 2.02 and 2.02A read)

checks.command: l4 run fwa-cases-employee.l4 ; l4 run fwa-cases-day-one.l4 ; l4 run fwa-cases-employer.l4 ; l4 run fwa-employee.l4 ; l4 run fwa-day-one.l4 ; l4 run fwa-seat-employer.l4

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the employee (and, for platform work, the employee-like worker), for the WA cradle-to-grave lives: ss 12 (vocational placement, junior employee), 13, 15AA (as an input), 15C, 15N, 15P, 22(5) and (7), 23, 45, 65, 65A, 67, 70, 71(3), 72A with reg 2.00, 76, 84, 87, 90, 96, 104, 106, 106A, 111, 115, 116B, 117, 118, 119, 121, 123, 382, 383 with reg 2.13, 385, 386, 389, 392(5), 394, 530, 536 with reg 3.46, 536KL, 536KM, 536KMA, 536LD, 536LU with reg 1.08AA, 544, 545(3) and (5), 548 with reg 4.01 (small claims capped at $100,000; no higher amount is prescribed). Modern award rates, the national minimum wage, and the current high income thresholds are inputs (the thresholds with the floors the Regulations guarantee: $100,000 and $175,000). Long service leave, enterprise agreements, casual conversion, general protections and civil penalties are out. Day one (fwa-day-one.l4 and the employer seat fwa-seat-employer.l4, 22 October 2026, REQ-0058): ss 44, 60, 61 (the NES as minimum standards a contract term cannot displace), s 125 (the Fair Work Information Statement), s 125B (the Casual Employment Information Statement, with the small business exceptions), s 333K (the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement), s 535 with regs 3.31 to 3.40 and 3.42 (employee records: the kinds, 7 years, form, inspection), s 557C (no records: the employer must disprove). The s 15A casual test and whether a term is an agreement an NES provision allows are inputs; ss 55-56 (awards and agreements against the NES), s 333E, regs 3.41, 3.43, 3.44 are out.
seat: the employee (and, for platform work, the employee-like worker of s 15P); and, in fwa-seat-employer.l4, the employer on day one
